# nlohmann/json

The single header is unmodified [nlohmann/json 3.11.3](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.11.3),
licensed under the MIT license embedded in the header.

SHA-256: `9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`.

The data service target keeps the same pinned version as its portable tests.
It does not change Chromium's own nlohmann/json dependency or its target visibility.
